Meat Head

Allergen Call Out: Wheat, Milk, Egg

Pre-bake ingredients, bottom to top

  1. 1 ea. Pizza Dough Ball [BOOM 0101]
  2. 170 g Grande Cheese Shredded Mozzarella
  3. 150 g Pizza Sauce [BOOM 0002]
  4. 90 g Fennel Sausage
  5. 45 g Pepperoni
  6. 1 ea. TILL Meatball [TILL022], Crumbled
  7. 20 g Shaved Garlic

Post bake, in order

  1. 4 g Basil
  2. 2 g Grated Romano Cheese
